records.source: Hey,^I thought it would be fun to send you a letter. I don't really know what to write, though.^ Here, I've enclosed a treat for you. records.source: @,^the show was a rockin' success! I wanted to say thanks again for all your help in creating this amazing band. We couldn't have done it without you!   ^   -Sam[#]Sam's Thank-you Note
records.translation: @,^napakalaking tagumpay ng palabas! Gusto kitang pasalamatan muli sa lahat ng tulong mo sa pagbuo ng kahanga-hangang bandang ito. Hindi namin iyon magagawa kung wala ka!   ^   -Sam[#]Liham ng Pasasalamat ni Sam

records.source: Dear @,^Thanks again for coming to my art show. It was such a success! I sold nearly all of my sculptures, and everyone was so positive and encouraging! I hope to see you again soon.  ^   -Leah[#]Leah's Thank-you Note
records.translation: Mahal kong @,^Salamat muli sa pagpunta sa palabas ng sining ko. Napakalaking tagumpay niyon! Halos lahat ng eskultura ko ay naibenta, at punô ng papuri at paghimok ang lahat! Sana magkita tayong muli agad.  ^   -Leah[#]Liham ng Pasasalamat ni Leah
